title: Kasia Niewiadoma Signs with Lidl-Trek in Move That Will Reshape the Women’s Peloton
content:
After second place at Tour de France and road worlds, Polish superstar steps away from Canyon-SRAM in quest to level with Demi Vollering.

Read the full article at Kasia Niewiadoma Signs with Lidl-Trek in Move That Will Reshape the Women’s Peloton on Velo.
author: Jim Cotton
